title: Verify: Current-Round lookup unit tests with mocked fetch
summary: Unit tests for findExecutionForRound and getCurrentRoundExecution
description: Extend tests/executions.test.ts to cover the pure helper and the async lookup with a URL-routing fetch stub.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts match by round_id, undefined when none, newest on tie
Test asserts the async lookup uses the current round id
technical_constraints: Fixtures roundFixture and executionFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts mirror world.Round JSON and execution.Execution JSON; spread them to vary round_id and updated_at

steps.action: Add tests: (1) list [{...executionFixture,id:'a',round_id:'round-1'},{...executionFixture,id:'b',round_id:'round-2'}] with 'round-1' returns id 'a'; (2) roundId 'round-9' returns undefined; (3) two round-1 entries with updated_at '2026-01-01T00:00:10Z' and '2026-01-01T00:00:50Z' returns the later one.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts -t findExecutionForRound

steps.action: Stub global fetch with a URL-routing vi.fn: '/api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current' returns roundFixture JSON, '/api/v1/admin/executions' returns [{...executionFixture,round_id:'round-2',id:'x'},{...executionFixture,id:'exec-1'}]. Assert getCurrentRoundExecution('tok') resolves to the entry with id 'exec-1' and that fetch was called with both URLs. Add a case where the list has only round-2 and assert undefined.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts -t getCurrentRoundExecution
